title: BetterDirectConnect
description: Simple QOL mod that stores the last servers you connected to, and shows them in the "Direct Connect" Menu to save you time.
body:
# BetterDirectConnect

A small client-side QoL mod for Fabric that upgrades the Direct Connect feature from vanilla.
When you join servers through Direct Connect, BetterDirectConnect keeps a recent history and shows it directly in the Direct Connect screen as compact, clickable entries. Click an entry to instantly reconnect.
If a server favicon is available, it’s shown next to the entry.
# Features
- Direct Connect history list (most recent first)
- One-click rejoin from Direct Connect
- Server Icon display for remembered servers (when available)
- ![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd8f4df0a7ab1d85196bb4dcc50870dff9ebeb13_0.webp)
- persistent accross game restarts

# Optional Cloth Config integration
Config (optional, via Cloth Config)
- Maximum remembered servers
- Panel position (X/Y)
- Panel width
- Row height
- Icon size
